pir_initial_lead_semantics: fixed public session-start lead before ordinal 0; prevents the first unconditional dummy from reducing M=50 capacity; frozen before any candidate-profile campaign
dummy_descriptor_contract: authenticated fixed-width descriptor with no real route, no Agent service, and no allowed Tool capability; result discarded
pir_recovery: nominal_i=T0+25ms+i*PIR_period; same no-drop/no-burst recurrence using public PIR period
late_commitment_rule: a prebuilt NOOP is the default logical commitment; only a REAL payload completed before the nominal cutoff may replace it
selection_rule: smallest public Delta and smallest PIR period satisfying full-transcript, functional, liveness, and development timing-equivalence criteria
